name: perl-statistics-descriptive
description: This tool provides basic descriptive statistical functions for numerical datasets using the Perl Statistics::Descriptive module. Use when user asks to calculate statistical summaries, generate frequency distributions, or perform memory-efficient data analysis in Perl.
overview: This skill provides guidance on using the `Statistics::Descriptive` Perl module to process numerical datasets. It is designed for scenarios where quick, programmatic statistical summaries are required without the overhead of a full statistical suite. It supports both "Sparse" (memory-efficient) and "Full" (retains all data points) methods of data accumulation.
